selectors.literal_quote: Payment services are always provided on a contractual basis between the payment services userand the payment services provider. Asstated in recital 87of thePSD2, "[t]his Directive shouldconcern only contractual obligations and responsibilities between the payment service user and thepayment service provider." In terms of the GDPR, themainlegal basis for the processing of personaldatafor the provision of payment servicesisArticle6(1)(b) of the GDPR, meaning that theprocessing is necessary for the performance of a contract to which the data subject is partyor inorder to take steps at the request of the data subject prior to entering into a contract.
